svg.title: RehabFM: audited shared representation training
svg.desc: Inputs follow waveform CNN or coordinate MLP branches. Learned queries and valid channel keys/values enter channel attention. Metadata forms a separate condition token, concatenated with window tokens. Loss values enter the joint objective, followed by backward and AdamW updates. The temporal inset has final LayerNorm after three repeated blocks.
svg.text: 16 external tasks + in-house training cohort | 4,065 raw records | 60 epochs | 10,500 updates
ReLU | dropout 0.3 | final norm follows the repeated stack
Separate modality streams; temporal weights are shared

g.text: L = L_mask + L_paired-old + 0.5 L_cross + L_var + 0.5 L_SupCon + 0.3 L_CE

svg.text: EEG cap and IMU are schematic illustrations.
